verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no first-party import or migration feature, such as a CSV importer or a tool-specific importer, for bringing data into Asana when switching tools. The REST API and task-creation quick start are developer building blocks. The directory listings for third-party sync apps (monday.com/Wrike/Jira sync, Skyvia, Hightouch) and the ongoing Jira data sync describe external or adjacent integrations, not Asana's own import capability.
